findings.file_not_found: chain.log: the third --plan (ar256-poison-epyc-r1) ran without --source-root, so host_vm_elems() looked for rtl/test/qwen_rom_runtime/qwen_rom_rt_w12.cpp under the tool's own parent (the scratch dir) and raised FileNotFoundError before writing a plan. The plan was re-made by hand with --source-root src/ (chain.log 11:31:06Z) and ran: 37/37 poisoned jobs exact. Not a simulation failure; nothing was left uncollected (all 113 exit.json present, --collect ran for the three plans).
findings.baseline_verify_rc1: base-epyc-r1: 39/39 jobs pass (37 singles + L18/head pairs), every stage bit-exact, composed 171,090 cycles == reference. rc=1 only because entry_state_composition_ok=false: 36 stages (L1..L35, head) read VM word 0 before writing it, a word an earlier stage wrote (4 words = word 0 on each die). That read is instruction 0's bypassed stream-unit B fetch (DEPSITE addr=0 port=1 cyc=19, ma/ad/md bypass), discharged for the baseline images by the earlier agidock poisoned run (results/rtl/qwen_rom_layer_parallel_20261003/poison/). This EPYC plan has no poison verdict, so the tool correctly refuses to compose it; the token result stands on the agidock record.
findings.ar256_verify_rc1: ar256-epyc-r1 without --poison-verdict: same word-0 flag, rc=1 by design.
findings.ar256_poison_rc1: ar256-poison-epyc-r1 alone: chain_covers=false because its L0 entry is the poisoned preload (sha differs from the plan preload) and composition is judged on the unpoisoned plan; all 37 poisoned jobs pass.
findings.ar256_final: verify of ar256-epyc-r1 with --poison-verdict: rc=0, composed_full_token_exact=true, 144,522 cycles. This discharges the AR256 VM-word-0 composition that results/rtl/qwen_rom_TP4_allreduce_oneseg_fulltoken_20261003 left open (no AR256 poison run there).

verdict: No defect. The rc=1 values are the tool's composition guard firing on plans without a poison verdict; the AR256 full token is now poison-discharged and exact (144,522 cycles).
